notes.title: Update 1.0.2.0
notes.content: A new feature of loading 3d .OBJ files has been included. You can now load 3d models exported from Blender or any other tool in .OBJ file format directly using this button [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666293/79a201caab34f554b1618d734e865c861e630345.png"] in the toolbar of body design tab.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.2
notes.content: Fix for localization. Now the app will adapt to the Steam client language settings.

notes.title: v1.0.1.1 – Hotfix: Steam Language Detection
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the application could not detect the Steam client’s language, causing localization to fail. The app now correctly reads the -language argument passed by Steam to match the client’s UI language.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.0
notes.content: This update includes localization for 28 languages and some bug fixes.
